limits: All cases are deterministic and synthetic.
Byte counts are a context-size proxy, not tokenizer-specific token or time savings.
Only one expected next-action case and one unsupported-completion case are measured.
Scope denial is application-layer local isolation, not hosted identity or database RLS.
No LLM provider, external repository, human reviewer, or proprietary agent client was used.
Agent B started from synthetic commit 7f52f9202d4b7246bc658b03947e1c735f26e440.
Graph lexical baseline returned 9 selected entities.
Secret scanning recognizes bounded known patterns and does not replace a provider scanner.
Instruction signals warn the client but cannot guarantee client-model compliance.
claim_boundary: Twelve deterministic synthetic regression cases; not an external accuracy, adoption, or production claim.
